fluff.overview: Word of Blake Militia infantry served as the backbone of Protectorate garrison forces across dozens of conquered worlds, providing the manpower for territorial control that the Militia's BattleMech and armor assets could not sustain alone. Mechanized tracked Level I formations rode APCs that could keep pace with armor across broken terrain, providing the all-terrain mobility and armor protection that garrison duty on undeveloped worlds demanded. The tracked transport kept these troops mobile even on worlds where roads were poor or nonexistent. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these troops deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
